name: Shree Karthik Papers Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1994, Shree Karthik Papers 
Ltd is in the business of paper manufacturing.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SKPL is in the business of manufacturing papers, which include Maplitho, Super Cream Wove, Cream Wove, White Wove, White Printing, Newsprint, Deluxe Semi Printing, etc.

cons: Stock is trading at 5.14 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 5.39% over past five years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.38 Cr.
